description:
Search 37 additional tools that are loaded on demand. Send one keyword query per capability you need; returns matching tool names and descriptions. Then `tool_describe` loads schemas and `tool_call` invokes. Tools already in your tool list need no search. Searches also cover the user's connected app accounts, whose tools are hosted and so never listed here (results named `connectors__<app>__<tool>`); `manage_connections` checks or connects an account and installs MCP servers.

Every tool listed below exists: never call it unavailable, and go straight to `tool_describe` when you see the exact name.

queries.description: One query per capability: service + action + object keywords (e.g. ['gmail send email', 'github create issue']), never a question; every word must match tool text. Searched in parallel.
